summary: Iteration 29 - Wallet and Teleconsultation Module Testing. Fixed critical JWT token validation bug in wallet.py and teleconsultation.py (was looking for 'user_id' instead of 'sub' in JWT payload). Fixed WalletWidget compact mode bug where dialog was not rendering. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend verified - Teleconsult page shows doctors, date/time slots, wallet widget with working top-up dialog.

fixed.issue: JWT token validation looking for 'user_id' instead of 'sub' - causing 401 errors for all authenticated wallet endpoints
fixed.fix: Updated get_current_user() to support both 'sub' and 'user_id' in JWT payload

fixed.issue: Admin verification only accepting 'admin' role, not 'super_admin'
fixed.fix: Updated verify_admin() to accept both 'admin' and 'super_admin' roles

fixed.issue: Same JWT token validation issue as wallet.py
fixed.fix: Updated get_current_user() to support both 'sub' and 'user_id' in JWT payload

fixed.issue: In compact mode, clicking wallet button set showTopUp=true but Dialog was not rendered (early return before Dialog components)
fixed.fix: Moved Dialog components to a shared renderDialogs() function that renders in both compact and full modes

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: JWT token validation in wallet.py and teleconsultation.py was using 'user_id' but server.py generates tokens with 'sub' claim
FIXED: WalletWidget compact mode was not rendering Dialog components due to early return
FIXED: Admin verification was only accepting 'admin' role, not 'super_admin' from admin login
All wallet and teleconsult APIs now working correctly with proper authentication

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet and Teleconsultation modules fully tested and working. JWT token validation bug was fixed in both wallet.py and teleconsultation.py (changed from 'user_id' to 'sub' claim). WalletWidget compact mode dialog rendering bug was fixed. All 22 backend tests pass. Frontend teleconsult booking flow works: select doctor → select date → select time slot → enter details → pay with wallet. Wallet top-up flow works: click wallet → enter amount → continue to payment → upload screenshot.
